about: The tree both languages build under a case-mixed root, to compare the OS sandbox settings and the refusals byte for byte (apps/bridge/test/os-sandbox-parity.test.ts and OsSandboxParityTests.swift). A path with `link` is a symbolic link to that text (`replace`: over what is there); one with `absolute` is made at that path (and removed after, its folder too when `removeDir`). Each case is the tree plus its own entries (a later entry for the same path replaces it) and, when it has `launchArgs`, Main's launch arguments; its golden line is the refusal of a whole start (the home's preflight first, then the launch arguments, then the folder's checks), or null. The settings are built with the user home `UserHome`, the kit release `Kit` and the agent folder `Agent`. `{ROOT}` in a file's text is the case's root. `trustedBridge` is what Talos recorded about its bridge, relative to the root (the bun, and `<clone>/apps/bridge`); a case may replace it, or set it to null (no record). It is the recorded value that both the settings (the clone is denied) and the `talos-app` server check use. A case may name its `folder` (relative to the root; default `Agent`) and set `loadsProject` to false (a thread outside the agent folder, which loads user settings only). A record may carry `bunInTemp` (its bun is in a shared temp folder: the record and its denies stay, a `talos-app` server entry is refused).
